items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Durante was in the show with us in Ziegfeld.

ctx.x: He says, 'man, can you imagine I get all this money for hugging these people. Sonny, did you ever think it would end up like this?' He was a big star and him and Jimmy Durante, and all them. They're our friends, we worked together.
Jimmy Durante was in the show with us in Ziegfeld. See, those guys, those big stars, they're so easy, so congenial to get along with. And they raise up if somebody try to lay
a hype on you. They'll raise up. Even today. They'll do it. They are so nice. We were handled so nice, man.
